about: Moonmere's Banded Cloisters module library, generated by tools/assets/build_moonmere_cloister_modules.py -- never hand-edit.

datums.depthRule: Rows are built to their rank's depth. Pitched roof slices are built for 9.0 and never stretched in depth; roof_flat, pergola, ret_flank, ret_low (and their LOD1s) are built for 9.0 and stretched in local z by axes to 8.0/8.5 only.
datums.frame: yaw = Babylon rotation.y: local +x = (cos yaw, -sin yaw), local +z = (sin yaw, cos yaw) = the front (MOONMERE.md D-13)
datums.roofPlacement: roof pieces at groundY + eave[rank] (the rank's ground; the eave datum includes the plinth)

MC_Stone.about: tufa, basalt, lime, pale stone: the facade group (night emissive)

MC_Timber.about: walnut timber, oak doors in the bays

MC_Glass.about: panes, lamp niches; lit by mc_facade_night.png

MC_Roof.about: roofs, eaves, ground and dressing: the trim group, NO emissive

MC_Joinery.about: shutters, door leaves, pentices: neutral, tinted per instance

MC_Metal.about: brass on civic pieces (telescopes, armillary, finials)

MC_Water.about: makeClearWaterMat; reserved: no module carries water

MC_Leaf.about: A-7: the trees' own RGBA sheet (leaf sprays, lemons, bark, tub, pot, soil); alpha tested, one submesh a tree

backFaceCulling: every material is single-sided (glTF doubleSided false): keep backFaceCulling on
vertexColor: COLOR_0 = baked AO x per-surface shade, grey only (normalised UNSIGNED_BYTE); useVertexColors, hasVertexAlpha = false. Per-instance wash / glaze / joinery tints multiply onto it
uv: glTF convention (origin top-left): load every sheet with invertY = false. TEXCOORD_0 is normalised UNSIGNED_SHORT where a primitive fits one sheet copy, else FLOAT (strips tile in U: sampler wrap REPEAT)

glazes.about: A-4 (look pass M2, MEASURED in the cloister-v2 roofscape and aerial): the glaze family's multipliers on the NEUTRAL pantile firing, so the multiplier alone sets the hue. Plum and smoke-violet are dE76 17.8 apart (the A-1 values on the old lilac firing: 6.2). client/src/zones/moonmere_kit.ts MM_TINTS.glaze must equal these (keys with underscores).

tint.about: one tint class per pool: altana takes glaze only; roof_flat takes WASH (A-4: its deck is paved in the pale tufa, a glaze turned it pink). Washes keep B >= 0.80 so the basalt bands stay blue (MOONMERE.md section 5).

interfaces.gatePassages: bay_ct_gate and bay_ct_loggia carry their own 9 m passage AND their court face: place NO bay_cy_win behind them
interfaces.interiors: home_in, oh_in_a, oh_in_b, shop_in are 3 bays (x -6..6) centred on the house's DOOR bay (its middle 4 m): the door / shop bay carries its own ground-storey inside face; the interior lines everything else
interfaces.mounts: a file's `mounts` (its own frame): lamp, sign, pentice, planter, vine, crates, nets (planDressing); shutters and door (the joinery pools: door_leaf at the mount, axes as given); cap (a tower's or turret's cap)
interfaces.roofFlat: roof_flat: the lap-edge balustrade (1.1 m) stands on z -9.3 .. -9.04 (x 0.889 for 8.0, x 0.944 for 8.5); collider is the planner's
interfaces.eaveBrk: eave_brk goes with roof_run / roof_hip_end / roof_gable_end slices (hip and gable crowns), never with roof_mono, roof_flat or roof_pav
